sentences.text: Therasia , also known as Thirasía , is an island in the volcanic island group of Santorini in the Greek Cyclades .	Santorini	Santorini	Greek	Greece	Cyclades	Cyclades

Therasia is the second largest island of the group , the largest by far being Thera .	Thera	Santorini
Therasia has a land area of 9.299 km ² and its population was 319 inhabitants at the 2011 census .
It is part of the municipal unit of Oia .	municipal unit	Communities and Municipalities of Greece	Oia	Oia, Greece
